verdict.rationale: GrowthBook is a feature-flag and experimentation platform, not an AI agent or tool-consuming host, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this product type. The evidence documents only the opposite role: an official MCP server that lets external AI tools such as Cursor, VS Code and Claude call GrowthBook. That server-side evidence belongs to a different story and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
